<description>
`-walletbroadcast` was a boolean `0` or `1` meaning either "do not broadcast transactions or "initial broadcast plus periodic re-broadcast (every 12-36 hours)".

Add a new possible value `initialonly` which would allow the user to configure the wallet to do the initial broadcast only and not to do the periodic rebroadcasts.

No new configuration options and no change in default behavior.
</description>
